translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Kart daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona' yell Rómana'

content: Daa nonḻilallaa Crístona' cho'a dill' ḻi, na' bi chziyaa. Na' ḻekzka' Espíritu Sántona' chzajniile' nad' kwenc̱he ṉezi yic̱hjlall'dawaani dga nia' nakan dii ḻi.
Ḻe nyesh' zoa' na' toshiizi ḻe chjeḻi lall'dawaani,
na' ax̱t sheḻ' wxe'id' bich gaklen Crístona' nad' na' kwiayaa kwenc̱he shicholə gaklenan beṉ' Israelka' beṉ'ka' nak beṉ' wlall c̱ha' na' beṉ' bishaa.

Chioza' wleje' dii x̱ozxto'nto'ka' kwenc̱he noni xiiṉe' neto'. Na' got' to balaaṉ c̱hegake' daa wzoalene' ḻegake'. Bc̱hebe' gakgake' yell c̱he', na' bi'e ḻegake' ley c̱he'na'. Na' bzajniile' ḻegake' ka chiyaḻ' we'la'ogake'ne', na' dii zan dii bc̱hebe' gone' c̱hegake'.

Neto' beṉ' Israel naknto' dia c̱he dii Abrahama', dii Isaaca' na' dii Jacoba', na' Crístona' ḻekzka' golje' lo dia c̱hento'na' ka bide' yell-lioni. Na' chiyaḻ' we'la'ochone' zejḻi kaṉi, ḻa' ḻen' nake' Chios na' chṉabi'e lao yog'ḻoḻte dii de. Kan' nakan.
Na' bi iṉacho Chioza' bi bene' ka bc̱hebe' gone' c̱hento', san daa gok, aga yog' beṉ'ka' golj lo dia c̱he dii Israela' nakgake' dowalj beṉ' Israel.
Aga yog' beṉ' goljgake' lo dia c̱he dii Abrahama' nakgake' dowalj xiiṉ dia c̱he'. Chioza' golle'ne': “Xiiṉo' Isaaki gakb' x̱axṉa' yog'ḻoḻ xiiṉ dia c̱ho'ka' zi' zaak.”
Dga chzajniin cho' nan aga ni c̱he nakgake' xiiṉ dia c̱he dii Abrahama' nakgake' xiiṉ Chios, san beṉ'ka' chajḻe' gone' ka bc̱hebe' gone', ḻegaken' noni xiiṉe'.
Ki nak daa bc̱heb Chioza' gone' c̱he dii Abrahama', chi'e: “Zi twiz ka ṉaa zaa dii yoblə, na' Sárana' sane' to xiiṉo' bi' byo.”
Na' aga dgazan. Ḻekzka' Rebécana' wxane' c̱hop bi'do' c̱he dii x̱ozxto'nto' Isaaca'.

Na' kana' zi' galj bi' kweshka', na' ni biṉ' gongakb' dii wen ni dii mal, Chioza' bshaljlene' Rebécana', golle'ne': “Bi'na' galjə nech wḻex̱j yic̱hjb' lao bi'na' galjə koll'baa.” Golle'ne' ka' kwenc̱he chakbe'icho Chioza' chbeje' beena' gak xiiṉe' kon ka ba bllie' bia' gak, na' chaxe' beṉ'ka' cheenile' gak xiiṉe', ni bi chone' kwent shi bi ba bengake'.
Nakan kon ka na Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' daa na: “Gokid' Jacoba', na' bwiyid' Esaúna'.”
¿Bera ka iṉacho, ṉaa? ¿Awak iṉacho Chioza' bi chone' wen? ¡Bi nakan ka'!
Ḻa' Chioza' golle' dii Moiséza': “Beena' cheenid' yiyesh'lallid' na' yiyesh'lallidee, na' beena' cheenid' gaklen' na' gaklenee.”
Daan, ṉezicho aga daa ḻe cheeni beṉ' gake' xiiṉ Chiozan' kwej Chioza'ne', ni aga ni c̱he bi dii chone'n, san Chioza' chbeje'ne' daa chiyesh'lallile'ne'.

Ḻa' Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' cho'en dill' ka golle' faraónna', beena' wṉabia' Egíptona': “Bzoa' li' chṉabi'o kwenc̱he gon' ka ile'i beṉ' yeḻ' wak c̱ha'na' na' kwenc̱he gakbe'i yog' beṉ' lle' doxen yell-lioni nad' nak' Chios.”
Na' kan' nakan, Chioza' chiyesh'lallile' beṉ'ka' cheenile' yiyesh'lallile', na' ḻekzka' chone' c̱hec̱h yic̱hjlall'do' beṉ'ka' cheenile' gakgake' beṉ' widenag.
Na' wnaljo': “Shi choncho kon ka ba nllia Chioza' bia' goncho, bi gak iṉe' napcho doḻ' lawe'na', ḻa' aga wakə wsej wlloncho gak ka cheenile'.”
Na' shi ka' chakilo', ¿nora nako' wsheshlenzo' Chioza'? Aga wak iṉe to yes' yo yeen beena' benan: “¿Bic̱he benzo' nad' ki?”
Ḻa' beena' chon yes' xwagka' wakə gone' beṉja' kon nak cheenile', na' wakte gone'n to yes' dii gon llin ga llialote, na' sto dii wc̱hine' c̱he bittez.

Na' ka'kzə ba ben Chioza'. Ni c̱he dii mala' chon beṉ' yell-lioni goklallee wliile' ḻegake' yeḻ' chllaa c̱he'na' na' gone' ka wli'lao yeḻ' wak c̱he'na', per wzoile' wdape' yeḻ' chxenlall' c̱he beṉ'ka' chidoḻ' yeḻ' zak'zi'na', beṉ'ka' ba nakan kwiayi'.
Na' ḻekzka', ba bli'e ka ḻiizelozi beṉ' wen inlleb nake' daa ba biyesh'lallile' cho' na' bizi'xene' c̱hecho, na' biyone' cho' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' kwenc̱he idoḻ'cho balaaṉ ka yillincho lawe'na'.
Na' ba gox wṉab Chioza' cho', aga baḻz neto' naknto' beṉ' Israelan', san len baḻ-le bi nakle beṉ' Israel.
Chak ka wna Chioza' daa bzej dii Oseaza', daa na:

content.text: Beṉ'ka' bi nak yell c̱ha', yepgakee: “Nakle yell c̱ha'.”
Na' beṉ'ka' bi gokid', yepgakee: “Chakid' le'.”
Na' latja' gana' golle' ḻegake' bi nakgake' yell c̱he',
wsi' beṉ' ḻegake' xiiṉ Chios yaa Chios ban.

content: Ki wna dii Isaíaza' c̱he beṉ' Israelka': “Ḻa'kzi shesh shan beṉ' Israelka' ax̱t gakgake' beṉ' zan ka yox daa chi' cho'a nisdo'na', baḻchokzgaken' yilagake' kwenc̱he bi kwiayi'gake'.
Ḻa' X̱ancho Chioza' ḻobe' wc̱hogbi'e ka gak c̱he yog' beṉ' lle' yell-lioni.”
Ka bzej dii Isaíaza', kana' wne':

content.text: Sheḻ' X̱ancho Chioza', beena' nak ḻiizelozi beṉ' yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen, bi bkwaaṉe' sto c̱hop dia c̱hechoka',
ba biyol binitcho ka gok c̱he beṉ' yell Sodómaka' na' beṉ' yell Gomórraka', sheḻ'ka'.

content: ¿Nakra iṉacho, ṉaa lla? Beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel bi wzegake' wṉeyi kwenc̱he yiyakgake' beṉ' wen lao Chioza', per daa benḻilall'gake'ne', ba biyakgake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na'.
San beṉ' Israelka', ḻa'kzi goklall'gake' yiyakgake' beṉ' wen lao Chioza' daa zejlengake' ley c̱he'na', bi wxakgakile'n.

Na' ¿bic̱he bi biyakgake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na'? Daa bi benḻilall'gake'nen'. Kon gokgakile' iṉa Chioza' nakgake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' daa chongake' daa na leya'. Na'ch gok c̱hegake' ka chak c̱he beṉ' chjac̱hew' yaj,
yaja' daa chzetj Cho'a Xtill' Chioza', daa na:

content.text: na' saklebile' ka to yaj daa chjac̱hew' beṉ', na' ka to yaj dii lljsho'gake' na' ibix̱gake'.
Na' beena' wx̱enilalleene', biga yiyajile' daa nx̱enilalleene'.
